Employees choose Athena Health Care Systems because they share our common goal of providing the best care to our residents. We, in turn, strive to provide the best care and work environment to our employees.
We create a welcoming work environment that allows you to grow your passion in healthcare. Whether a member of our nursing staff, therapy team, or any other crucial department, you matter to the residents, their families, and the Athena family.
Through staff appreciation events, Employee of the Month programs, and a positive company culture, we hope you find a lifelong career with Athena. Just ask our many employees with decades-long careers with us! While we work to provide the highest-quality care to hundreds of residents in our communities, we know that can’t be done without the passionate folks we employ across Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Rhode Island.

We know you are always looking ahead and so are we! Athena offers various opportunities for career advancement. For example, many of our Certified Nursing Assistants will pursue nursing degrees and continue their careers where they started it. It’s not uncommon to find someone in a supervisor or director role grown from within. You are also able to transfer within the Athena family and maintain your seniority. We like to give everyone the space to grow on a personal and professional level and reach their full potential.

Let Your Skills SHINE
ARE YOU CHEERFUL, HARDWORKING AND FLEXIBLE?
Join our outstanding staff at a beautiful & progressive retirement community. We provide good hourly wages, paid holidays, sick time, personal time, vacation time, and a pension plan. Please submit both an application form and a references form to be considered for employment.
Noble Horizons’ 110 acre campus offers a spectacular setting with exceptional amenities that, for almost half a century, have been enhanced by a proud tradition of teamwork. Our values are reflected in the many advancement opportunities staff enjoy as well as the career longevity. Flexible schedules to fit family and school needs; a supportive administrative team; a newly renovated, comfortable and generously stocked staff room; and a shared pride in the work we do together are just some of the reasons why Noble Horizons could be the right fit for you.

jobs.city: 1. Be skeptical of personal e-mail addresses. Any legitimate recruiter
jobs.description:
SCAM Alert
As we continue to evolve through the digital age, consumers need to be aware of online scams that use false employment opportunities. These opportunities can service in a multitude of ways from a fraudulent job posting to scammers reaching out to you about a potential work-from-home job. LHC Group cares about the communities we serve and we want to ensure you are prepared for these criminal acts.

Here are a few key steps to help identify the authenticity of the job you are interested in:

1. Be skeptical of personal e-mail addresses. Any legitimate recruiter, HR person, or hiring manager will contact you from a corporate e-mail and never Gmail, Hotmail, AOL, Yahoo, or other free personal e-mail addresses.
2. Never pay to get a job. Legitimate employers will never ask you to send money to acquire a job.
3. Never accept money before working. Never agree to have money deposited into any of your accounts during the job search process.

Our Benefits
Our employees play an important role in helping Bristol Hospital and Health Care Group deliver quality care every day in the community, and as such, we are committed to offering them a comprehensive, cost-effective benefits package that meets their needs.  
 
We recognize the importance of total well-being. Not only do we want our patients to live their best lives, but we also want our employees and their families to have the resources they need to thrive. When you work here, you can feel confident in knowing that you’re making a difference in a job that supports you personally and professionally.
